summary: Tested new tab-based UX (TabExplorer) + regression on booking flow. Backend endpoints verified (/api/availability for both apt ids = 200, /api/bookings/status/{missing} = 404). Frontend: all 7 tabs render in sticky bar, fit at 1366px (no overflow), each tab shows correct panel, apartment preselect from Brufani Due works, header/hero CTAs dispatch open-tab correctly, EN language switch translates tab labels (Prenota->Book, Posizione->Location), lightbox opens/closes, ?pagamento=annullato auto-activates Prenota tab and shows error toast, ?checkin=test&token=test renders CheckInPage (not landing) with handled 'Link non valido' error, mobile 390px: tab bar horizontally scrollable, hamburger opens mobile nav and clicks tabs. No regressions found.

issues: Sonner toast at top-center can overlap the hamburger menu toggle area briefly (minor; dismiss or click works after).

critical_code_review_comments: TabExplorer open-tab listener uses setActive(e.detail) with no validation: an unknown tab id would blank the panel area (defensive guard would be nice).
AnimatePresence exit leaves panel in DOM briefly (count=1 right after close) which is expected but can double-mount heavy panels; consider lazy mounting non-prenota panels only when visited.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tab UX verified at desktop 1366 and mobile 390. All 7 data-testid tabs: tab-brufani, tab-brufanidue, tab-perche, tab-galleria, tab-posizione, tab-recensioni, tab-prenota. Backend untouched. Stripe not exercised beyond availability call.
